implementation: Canonical PostgreSQL-to-ClickHouse producers now propagate enqueue failures when they share the PostgreSQL transaction; no-connection demo/maintenance writes retain warning-only behavior.
The outbox raises OutboxEnqueueError for database enqueue failures and idempotency-key payload conflicts, allowing runners to distinguish a failed projection from a recoverable provider failure.
Weather and RPC runners rollback and close instead of committing source rows without an outbox record.
Remote-sensing provider dispatch, subgraph and EAS indexing, and Gnosis governance indexing roll back and propagate outbox failures instead of treating them as ordinary provider errors.

Nine producer helpers are covered: weather, manual/GEE/Copernicus remote sensing, subgraph/EAS attestations, two Gnosis projections, and RPC wallet activity. Existing sensor and forecast producers retain their separate transaction guarantees.

limitations: This verifies source and transaction-control behavior with mocks; live provider delivery and disposable PostgreSQL transaction acceptance remain separate gates.
The work does not establish worker authorization, tenant isolation, or RLS and changes no MAN-CAP acceptance status.
